player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Sokoban puzzle kasha ai hte. Nanhte player sha re, box mahkra chyu sha hte target ni kau ai.
        Box langai hta nanhte kaja wa ai shaloi, nanhte box kau ai hte shang lawu na.
        Nanhte box wa hte shinggan hte sha re pyi, box wa hte langa pyi.
        Board hta object ni hte: 
        - Player (nanhte) 'P' hte kaja ai 
        - Shinggan '#' hte kaja ai 
        - Box 'X' hte kaja ai 
        - Empty goal 'O' hte kaja ai
        - Box goal hta '√' hte kaja ai
        Nanhte [w] hte up, [a] hte left, [s] hte down, [d] hte right hte sha re.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hkum htai na matut ai hpe gaw na shan htai. [up], [down], [left], [right] ya [w], [a], [s], [d] hpe gaw shalai.
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Kau ai lam hte aja hta na re.
invalid_move.wall_collision: Hpungdim de nang n sa lu ai.
invalid_move.invalid_position: N-gun n rawng ai shamu shamawt lam - dai shara de htaw bang lu na n re.

outcome.win: Kabu gara ai. Nang gaw Sokoban manghkang hpe hparan lu sai!
outcome.turn_limit: Hpang jahtum na matu, nang n lu galaw sai.
